game_concept: A racing platformer set in Shadow Cave – Mushroom Cavern, a cavern of glowing mushrooms: the dwarf scout must handle zombies while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Break Out: Use break to leave a loop the moment a dangerous foe is spotted.
theme: Shadow Cave – Mushroom Cavern: a cavern of glowing mushrooms
core_gameplay_loop: In Mushroom Cavern, repeat each round: Use break to leave a loop the moment a dangerous foe is spotted. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the dwarf scout ahead. Then check the alert value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the supply cache by solving code steps involving alert that move the dwarf scout forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.55).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the supply cache first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Break Out
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Break Out' (Week 4 slot 10), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Mushroom Cavern'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how alert changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against zombies in Mushroom Cavern.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.55).
